   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 27, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _anthonyb176_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "The app doesn’t always track steps, distance, or workouts accurately. If I end a workout at 9800 steps and then walk 200 steps, the app still says I only walked 9800 steps. A lot of the workouts that should be standard are also locked unless you buy additional hardware. 9/18/26 Sharing fitness data with other contacts doesn’t work. My wife and I can’t share with each other our any of our friends from either of our devices or accounts. It just says “There was an error sending your activity sharing invitation. Try sending it again.” This has been an issue for the past 6 months, at least."
            2. _Vanessalikescake_, Sep 13, 2026, 1/5: "Every time I do a workout it freezes and goes on a loop without finishing the workout routine. It’s frustrating and causing me to waste a lot of time."
            3. _Beef_Curtains_, Sep 13, 2026, 1/5: "When i synced it to my google health app it doubled all my steps and there was no fixing it. I tried for hours but its broken. Feels like i lost all my hard-work and data because of a dumb technical glitch."
